entries.author: Arbel_Gaming
entries.title: 你是哪位 X 战警：角色变身
entries.note: 需上传自己的角色图；英文长提示词在作者第一条回复里。
entries.prompt:
@image1 - is the main and only character reference.

The character must remain fully recognizable and faithful to the original reference image.

Do not change, invent, obscure, or drift from the character's original design.

Preserve the following characteristics exactly as seen in @image1: face shape, eye color, eye shape, mouth, hairstyle, hair color, ears, race, gender, species, age, markings, body proportions, and overall silhouette.

Character name: [Your Name].

Carefully analyze the reference character's color scheme, visual aesthetic, personality, temperament, character archetype, and overall vibe before making a selection.

Based on this analysis, select ONE X-Men character from the 1992–1997 X-Men animated series whose personality, mutant abilities, visual aesthetic, and overall character concept best complement the original character.

The selection must be based on genuine overall compatibility rather than superficial similarities such as gender, hairstyle, hair color, or popularity.

Consider the ENTIRE available character roster before making the final selection.

Do not automatically gravitate toward the most recognizable or frequently associated characters. Avoid repeatedly choosing Rogue, Jean Grey, or Psylocke for female characters, and Gambit or Wolverine for male characters. These characters remain valid choices when they genuinely offer the strongest match, but they must not be treated as default selections.

Give equal consideration to less frequently selected characters. Explore the full range of available personalities, powers, aesthetics, and character archetypes. Unexpected but meaningful combinations are encouraged whenever they offer a compelling match.

Each reference sheet must be evaluated independently. Do not allow previous character selections to influence the current selection.

Available female characters include: Jean Grey, Storm (Ororo Munroe), Rogue, Jubilee (Jubilation Lee), Psylocke (Betsy Braddock), Emma Frost, Mystique (Raven Darkholme), Scarlet Witch (Wanda Maximoff), Polaris (Lorna Dane), Moira MacTaggert, Madelyne Pryor, Lilandra Neramani, Deathbird (Cal'syee Neramani), Spiral, and Lady Deathstrike (Yuriko Oyama).

Available male characters include: Wolverine (Logan), Cyclops (Scott Summers), Beast (Hank McCoy), Gambit (Remy LeBeau), Professor X (Charles Xavier), Archangel (Warren Worthington III), Nightcrawler (Kurt Wagner), Forge, Cable (Nathan Summers), Bishop (Lucas Bishop), Iceman (Bobby Drake), Morph (Kevin Sidney), Colossus (Piotr Rasputin), Sunfire (Shiro Yoshida), Longshot, Shatterstar, Thunderbird (John Proudstar), Havok (Alex Summers), Strong Guy (Guido Carosella), and Warlock.

Select a character appropriate to the original character's gender. Never change the original character's gender or physical identity.

Dress the original character in a highly recognizable and faithful interpretation of the selected X-Men character's iconic costume from the 1992–1997 animated series.

The original character's face, hairstyle, hair color, physical features, and overall identity must remain unchanged. The character is COSPLAYING as the selected X-Men character, not transforming into them.

Naturally adapt the selected X-Men character's costume, signature accessories, and iconic design elements to the original character's proportions and appearance.

The character must visibly demonstrate the signature mutant powers of the selected X-Men character, integrated naturally and dramatically into the scene. The displayed powers must be recognizable, visually impressive, and consistent with the selected character's actual abilities.

Create a dynamic, cinematic scene that captures the selected X-Men character's personality, powers, and visual identity while allowing the original character's own personality and aesthetic to shine through.

Generate a high-quality anime illustration highly inspired by the 1992–1997 X-Men animated series, featuring its distinctive character designs, expressive facial features, bold outlines, vibrant colors, dramatic comic-book compositions, dynamic poses, and classic cel-shading aesthetics.

Generate a 3:5 portrait composition.

Position the character prominently within the scene, ensuring the full costume and signature mutant powers are clearly visible.

At the bottom of the image, incorporate a beautifully designed, visually integrated information box.

The information box must contain:

Original Character: [Your Name]

X-Men Cosplay: [Selected X-Men Character]

Why This Match: A short, thoughtful explanation of why the selected X-Men character complements the original character, referencing their personality, color palette, visual aesthetic, or other defining characteristics.

Ensure all text is correctly spelled, legible, and neatly arranged without obscuring the character or important scene details.

The final artwork should have a masterpiece-level finish, with crisp rendering, beautiful color composition, intricate costume details, polished cel shading, professional promotional-poster quality, and exceptional visual clarity.

Avoid:
Incorrect character selection, repetitive character selections, defaulting to popular characters, changing the original character's identity, altered facial features, changed hairstyles, changed hair colors, gender changes, inaccurate costumes, inaccurate mutant powers, generic superhero costumes, low quality, worst quality, blurry images, bad anatomy, extra fingers, missing fingers, extra digits, missing digits, deformed features, ugly appearances, ugly faces, JPEG artifacts, logos, watermarks, unreadable text, cropped subjects, and unwanted cropping.

entries.prompt:
Create a vertical 3:4 casual indoor selfie of a fictional, clearly adult 22-year-old East Asian woman resting on her forearms among cool-toned cushions at night. Keep an everyday close camera angle, slightly below eye level, with the face in the upper middle and the near forearm traveling diagonally toward the lower right. Put a little space above her dark hair and keep the pendant and both shoulders inside the picture. Her torso is angled gently toward the right and her head turns back toward the lens. She meets the camera with a level attentive gaze and relaxed closed lips. Keep a believable adult jaw and cheek shape, naturally scaled dark eyes, straight subtle brows, a softly rounded nose, muted coral lips and fine skin texture. Make her adult head-to-shoulder proportions natural, with a slender relaxed frame and no exaggeration.

Her dark hair is tied back loosely behind her head. Two narrow strands fall by her temples and the part is slightly off-center. Add a small stud on the visible ear and a fine gold chain with a small oval ring pendant. The chain follows the turn of her neck and its pendant hangs naturally. Dress her in a securely fitted, fully opaque pale blue-gray ribbed bandeau-style top with a modest straight-to-softly-curved neckline. Keep its fine cotton ribs and small folds natural. Her forearms rest on textured neutral bedding, with hands partly outside the close crop. Keep visible skin free of tattoos.

Set the portrait against a dim blue-gray room corner. On the right behind her, show a softly defocused screen showing only a patch of ultramarine and violet light, with a dark patterned curtain and a few gray cushions nearby. Keep the room softly lit and the identifying details absent. Use a broad warm-neutral light close to the camera, enough to shape the nearer cheek and shoulder. Keep a faint cool edge on the opposite side, low-key shadows and realistic soft grain. Allow subtle bedding pattern changes and maintain the quietly informal feeling of taking a quick picture in a dim room. Keep the screen and background free of lettering and logos.

entries.author: abs_crea8or
entries.title: 男士编辑感写真拼图
entries.note: 需上传自己的照片作身份参考。
entries.prompt:
Use my uploaded reference photo as the primary identity reference. Create an ultra-realistic, high-resolution professional editorial photography collage featuring the exact same man in every frame.

1. IDENTITY PRESERVATION — HIGHEST PRIORITY

Preserve the subject's exact facial identity throughout all nine photographs. Maintain his original face shape, forehead, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, ears, jawline, skin tone, hairstyle, hairline, age, and natural facial proportions.

Every panel must feature the same recognizable person. Do not change his identity, facial structure, hairstyle, or physical appearance between photographs. Avoid artificial facial enhancement, excessive retouching, or unrealistic skin smoothing.

2. PHOTOGRAPHY STYLE

Create a sophisticated black-and-white luxury editorial photoshoot with:

- Timeless monochrome photography.
- Professional fashion magazine aesthetics.
- Soft studio lighting and natural shadows.
- Beautifully balanced highlights and deep blacks.
- Realistic skin texture and fine facial details.
- Minimalist grey studio background.
- Elegant, masculine, confident, and relaxed expressions.
- Professional DSLR photography quality.

3. COLLAGE LAYOUT — NINE DIFFERENT PHOTOGRAPHS

Arrange nine different photographs into one cohesive, asymmetrical editorial collage.

- Frame 1: Extreme close-up facial portrait, looking directly into the camera with a calm, confident expression.
- Frame 2: Medium portrait, sitting casually with one hand supporting his head, wearing a black T-shirt and wristwatch.
- Frame 3: Side-angle portrait wearing a simple white T-shirt, looking slightly upward.
- Frame 4: Close-up portrait with one hand resting thoughtfully near his chin, wearing a black shirt and wristwatch.
- Frame 5: Stylish side-profile portrait wearing dark sunglasses and a black jacket.
- Frame 6: Relaxed smiling portrait with one hand running through his hair, wearing a black hoodie.
- Frame 7: Full-body seated fashion portrait wearing a black jacket, white T-shirt, black trousers, and stylish sneakers.
- Frame 8: Casual seated portrait wearing a white button-up shirt and dark trousers, with a relaxed pose.
- Frame 9: Dramatic low-angle close-up portrait highlighting his facial features and natural expression.

4. COMPOSITION AND DESIGN

- Vertical 9:16 aspect ratio.
- Nine individual photographs arranged in an asymmetrical magazine-style grid.
- Mix of close-up, medium, side-profile, and full-body compositions.
- Clean white diagonal and horizontal dividers separating each photograph.
- Slightly varied panel sizes for a sophisticated editorial layout.
- Consistent grey studio background across all frames.
- No overlapping photographs.
- Balanced spacing and carefully aligned borders.
- Every photograph must look like an individual professional studio shot from the same photoshoot.

5. CLOTHING AND ACCESSORIES

Use coordinated minimalist outfits in black and white, including black T-shirts, white shirts, black jackets, hoodies, dark trousers, sneakers, and a stylish wristwatch. Keep the wardrobe elegant, contemporary, and understated.

6. FINAL QUALITY REQUIREMENTS

The final image must look like a professionally art-directed luxury fashion magazine contact sheet, not an ordinary photo collage.

Prioritize photorealism, consistent facial identity, natural expressions, realistic anatomy, accurate hands, detailed clothing textures, balanced monochrome contrast, and premium editorial composition.

STRICT NEGATIVE INSTRUCTIONS: No duplicated faces, no identity changes, no inconsistent hairstyles, no distorted facial features, no extra fingers, no unnatural hands, no cartoon effects, no color photographs, no text, no logos, no watermarks, and no unnecessary decorative elements.

FINAL OUTPUT: One seamless, ultra-realistic, premium black-and-white nine-photo editorial portrait collage in vertical 9:16 format.
